pairs.difference: A has a pale upper face that turns into a distinctly shaded circular side and underside. B spreads a broad sheen across the whistle's front, with gentler separation between its lit face and rounded side.
pairs.fix: Light the upper face clearly, deepen the circular side and underside, and narrow the soft shine along the front edge.

pairs.difference: A's narrow tubing turns sharply from bright edges into dark undersides. B has wider white highlight bands around the loop and bell rim, making more of the horn appear illuminated at once.
pairs.fix: Keep the bright reflections narrow on the tubing, with darker undersides and a clearer shaded side inside the bell.

pairs.difference: A's cup front, handle and saucer carry broad bright areas with relatively gentle form shadows. B has a clearer shaded left wall, a lit right wall and deeper contact beneath the cup.
pairs.fix: Shade one side of the cup more deeply, carry that direction through the handle, and keep the brightest saucer reflection on the light-facing edge.

pairs.difference: A has soft highlights across the apples and deeper shading beneath the basket weave. B has more concentrated apple highlights and a darker basket underside. Both show coherent form turns and cast shadows; neither gives a decisive lighting-only mismatch.

A's barrel has a strongly shaded left wall and a bright right wall, with the bands following that division. B distributes broad highlights across the front staves and bands, leaving a less distinct shadow side.
pairs.fix: Put the barrel's left side into deeper shade, brighten the right-facing staves, and let the metal bands follow the same light direction.

pairs.difference: A has a bright roof and hood above deeply shaded wheels and lower body. B adds broad bright reflections to both fenders and bumper ends, opening the lower forms and weakening that light-to-shadow separation.
pairs.fix: Keep the roof and hood bright, deepen the wheel wells and lower body, and reduce the wide white reflections across the bumper and fenders.

pairs.difference: A's large left tent panel sits in shade while the entrance folds catch concentrated light. B spreads soft illumination over both roof slopes and several entrance folds, producing a gentler turn into shadow.
pairs.fix: Shade the left roof panel more deeply, concentrate sunlight on the right entrance folds, and darken the fabric beneath overlapping flaps.

pairs.difference: A's pot has a localized bright left patch and a deeply shaded right belly. B carries a broad sheen across the upper belly and bright edges around much of the rim, with weaker directional separation despite the fire beneath.
pairs.fix: Give the pot a clearly shaded side, limit the upper reflection to one patch, and concentrate the firelight on the bottom curve and nearby stones.

pattern: The generated examples tend to spread broad sheen over several faces and open the shadow side, weakening the real cards' clearer directional form turns.
